listings.description: Petty Son & Prestwich are delighted to offer to rent this spacious and stylish two bedroom ground-floor apartment, set within the highly desirable and characterful Wanstead Hospital Development.  Ideally positioned just 0.5 miles from both Snaresbrook Station and Wanstead High Street, the property combines contemporary interiors with the charm and convenience of this sought-after East London location.  Wanstead is renowned for its village-like atmosphere, offering an appealing mix of independent shops, cafés, bars and restaurants. Excellent transport connections are available via the Central Line at Wanstead, Snaresbrook and South Woodford, alongside numerous bus routes and convenient access to the M11, M25 and North Circular Road.  Upon entering, a spacious hallway sets the tone for the apartment's clean, contemporary aesthetic. Crisp white walls and dark wood flooring create a smart, cohesive finish, with the flooring continuing seamlessly into the principal living space and kitchen.  The generous lounge and dining area is a particular highlight, featuring an attractive bay window that allows natural light to fill the room. An elegant archway leads through to the kitchen, creating a natural transition between the two spaces while maintaining a sense of openness. The kitchen is fitted with high-gloss white cabinetry, complemented by a black worktop for a striking, modern finish.
